caption: The drawing is a monochromatic pencil sketch on off-white paper depicting a long-sleeved, ankle-length garment viewed from the back. The garment features a high, close-fitting collar and detailed yoke design with a repeated diamond and leaf pattern, rendered with fine lines and shading. The yoke extends over the shoulders and converges to a point at the center back. The sleeves are loose, gathered at the cuffs, which are also decorated with a similar intricate pattern as seen on the yoke and collar. A central row of small, round button fastenings is shown running vertically down the length of the garment from the collar to the hem. The cloth drapes in soft, gradual folds, giving a sense of volume and flow. The drawing is signed “Edith Millr” in small letters at the bottom right.
title: Woman's Nightgown
